title: Hatch Fill Demo
description: Demonstrates hatch: command for solid walls, structural zones, and restricted areas.
script:
title: Hatch Fill Demo
units: m
world: -30, -20, 30, 20
grid: 1.5
wallwidth: 0.25
wallcolor: #1e4a6e

# ── STRUCTURAL WALL (dense 45° hatch) ──────────────────────────────
hatch: -28, 18, -20, -18, 45, 0.4
^text: Structural Wall

# ── RESTRICTED ZONE (tight crosshatch) ─────────────────────────────
hatch: -18, 8, -8, -8, 45, 0.6
hatch: -18, 8, -8, -8, -45, 0.6
rect: -18, 8, -8, -8, nowall
^text: Restricted Zone
^icon: restricted

# ── LOAD-BEARING COLUMN (small dense crosshatch) ───────────────────
hatch: -4, 4, 0, 0, 45, 0.3
hatch: -4, 4, 0, 0, -45, 0.3
^text: Column

# ── MAIN ROOM ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rect: 2, 12, 28, -12
^text: Main Space

door: 2, 4, 2, 2

# ── SOLID PARTITION (coarse -45°) ──────────────────────────────────
hatch: 10, 12, 12, -12, -45, 0.8
^text: Partition

# ── STORAGE (medium 45°) ───────────────────────────────────────────
rect: 14, 12, 28, 4
^text: Storage
hatch: 14, 12, 28, 4, 45, 0.5
^nowall

# ── HAB CORRIDOR (exterior wall fill) ──────────────────────────────
hatch: -28, -10, 28, -18, 45, 0.5
^text: Hab Wall

label: -10, 16, 10, 18, hatch demo
